subject: RM_TwitcherVenomvine
departures: a clump of whip-thin, flexible canes rather than stiff, jointed upright bamboo poles
at least one cane held cocked back in a tensed, drawn-whip curve, poised to strike like a rearing snake
some canes visibly spent: slack, limp and drooping toward the ground, in contrast with the tensed one
the striking cane ends in a distinct venom-bearing tip, not a leaf, bud or plain taper
